original_value: The Nimbus Arc 27 is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for vibrant color work and smooth gaming. It features a QHD IPS panel with a 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, adaptive sync support, and a fully adjustable stand. Connectivity includes DisplayPort and dual HDMI inputs, plus a USB hub for peripherals. The display is tuned for wide viewing angles and factory-calibrated color accuracy, making it suited for creative suites and general-purpose workstations.
